name: romdev-core-runner
description: Play a ROM you just built: an SDL window over the romdev libretro host (romdev-core-host) with keyboard + hot-plug gamepad input, audio, and aspect-correct pixel-perfect scaling. The human 'fire it up' tier between an external emulator and the romdev MCP server. Bundles NO cores; pass any romdev-core-* package.
author: Luis Montes
